Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is it from this game. We have got our four semi-finalists, Pakistan, India, New Zealand and England. However, the action continues as India takes on Zimbabwe at the MCG and that game is set to begin at 1.30 pm IST (8 am GMT). You can switch tabs to follow all the updates. Cheers!

Babar Azam, the skipper of Pakistan is up for a chat. He says that he is happy with the performance. Adds that the pitch was a bit tricky and the plan for him and Mohammad Rizwan was to take the game deep, but it did not work out. Tells that it was good to see Mohammad Haris bat with some aggression. Ends by saying that they are all excited to play in the semi-finals.

Shakib Al Hasan, the captain of Bangladesh is up for a chat. He says that with the start that they got, they should have got something around 150. Mentions that the pitch was slow and it was not easy for the new batters. Tells that this is their best ever T20 World Cup campaign, but they could have done better. Ends by saying that as long as he remains fit he would love to play for his team.

Shaheen Afridi is the player of the match for his amazing bowling performance. He says that he has improved. Adds that it is not easy to bowl at the same pace after coming back from a injury. Mentions that as a team they have played good and tells that the plan was to bowl in the right areas. Ends by saying that they are actually looking towards the finals.
Presentation Time...

Earlier in the day, after electing to bat, Bangladesh got off to a good start but some brilliant bowling from Pakistan led by Shaheen Afridi's four-fer, restricted them to a low score which was quite easily chased.

Bangladesh were just not up for this game to be honest. After a disappointing display with the bat, the bowling and the fielding wasn't great either. There were quite a few extras and an important drop of Mohammad Rizwan earlier on too. Saying that, they just did not have enough on the board. Maybe another 20 runs and things could have been different.

127 was never going to be enough to be honest and the openers got Pakistan off to a steady start. Both fell in quick succession but then came the innings which took the game away from Bangladesh and it came from the bat of Mohammad Haris. He went after the bowlers right from the word go and got able support from Shan Masood. Their stand took Pakistan to the brink of victory before Haris fell. Masood though ensured there were no more wickets to fall and took their side over the line.

Pakistan, Pakistan it is who storm into the semi finals with a very convincing win over Bangladesh. What a turn around on this last day of the Super 12 stage. At the start of the day, not many would have predicted Pakistan to go through but they grabbed the opportunity that came to them after Netherlands beat South Africa and now are the fourth and final side to make it through.

Shan Masood hits the winning runs! Ebadot Hossain serves this full and on the pads, Shan Masood flicks it towards fine leg for two runs. The whole Pakistan dugout jumps up in joy. PAKISTAN WIN BY 5 WICKETS AND THEY ARE THROUGH TO THE SEMI-FINALS.
Shadab Khan is the next batter in for Pakistan.

OUT! TAKEN! Mustafizur Rahman gets another wicket, but it is too little too late for Bangladesh. Mustafizur Rahman bowls the slower delivery, on off, Iftikhar Ahmed goes for the big slog, but gets a top edge straight up in the air towards the cover-point region where Najmul Hossain Shanto keeps his eyes on the ball, turns around and takes a really good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Najmul Hossain Shanto b Mustafizur Rahman

Commentary.Commentary: A yorker, on off, Shan Masood digs it out towards deep point for a single.
Short and on middle, Shan Masood pulls it towards deep square leg for a brace.

Mustafizur Rahman nails the yorker, on off, Shan Masood is late to put his bat down to play at it and it goes through to the keeper. Nurul Hasan throws it at the bowler's end, but it hits the umpire. Shan Masood calls for the run, but he is sent back and rightly so.
This is on a good length and on middle, Iftikhar Ahmed bunts it onto his pads as the ball rolls to the off side. The batter takes a quick run as Mustafizur Rahman misses his shy at the batter's end.
Short of a length and around off, Shan Masood cuts it towards deep point for a single.
On a length and on middle, Iftikhar Ahmed kncoks it back to the bowler.
Iftikhar Ahmed comes out to the middle now.

OUT! TAKEN! Mohammad Haris looks to finish things off early, but throws his wicket away. Shakib Al Hasan slows it up and bowls this around off, Mohammad Haris skips down the track and tries to clear the in-field, but he only manages to slice it uppishly towards cover-point where Nasum Ahmed takes a nice leaping catch. Haris is not happy with himself as he wanted to stay till the end.
Commentary.Howout: c Nasum Ahmed b Shakib Al Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: A bit short and on middle, Shan Masood tucks it through square leg for one.

FOUR! Another one for Masood! Shakib Al Hasan loops this up, full and on off, Shan Masood waits for it, goes down and sweeps it towards the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary. Pakistan need 8 runs now.
Good running! This is tossed up, full and on middle, Shan Masood nudges it towards deep square leg for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Really well placed! Finds the gap nicely! Shorter and outside off, this is pushed past the fielder at cover and into the fence. Pakistan want to end quickly now.
Singles will do it for Pakistan! On middle, this is nudged through mid-wicket for one. End of another huge over.
Another single! Shorter again, Mohammad Haris pulls it through mid-wicket and takes one.
Two! Very well placed again! Shorter and on off, Haris pulls it gently on the leg side for a couple. 20 needed now.
SIX! BANG! That is probably the hit which kills the game. Just the 22 needed now! This is right in the slot. Full and on off, Haris walks across and heaves it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
On the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one. ALSO, IT IS A NO BALL! Not what Bangladesh wanted. Haris gets a Free-Hit. Not like he needs an invitation to go after the bowlers though.
Excellent running now! Outside off, Masood guides it towards third man with soft hands. The weight on the shot is really good. Two taken.
Lands safe again! Luck just not favoring Bangladesh! Shorter and on middle, Masood looks to pull, it goes off the top edge but lands ahead of the fielder at mid on who runs back. Two taken.
Taskin Ahmed (2-0-10-0) is back on.
Safe! Slows it up, lands it on middle, Shan Masood looks to play the reverse sweep but is through the shot. It goes off the glove but lobs over the keeper for one. Excellent over by Shakib.
On middle, Haris pulls it towards deep mid-wicket, only one.
Shan Masood walks out to the middle now.

OUT! NAWAZ IS SHORT! Bangladesh strike just as Pakistan were running away with the game. That is brilliant from Das. Excellent stuff! On off, this is pushed towards him at cover. They go for one. Das gets to the ball quickly, turns and then hits the stumps at the bowler's end. It is taken upstairs and replays show that Nawaz is short of his crease.
Shorter and outside off, Haris slaps it through covers for one more.
On middle, this is worked down to long on for one.
On middle, this is swept through square leg for one.
Shakib Al Hasan comes back into the attack now. He has conceded 19 runs in his two overs.
A dot to end but the damage was done earlier on! A huge over and the tide has completely shifted towards Pakistan now. 39 needed in 36.
Another short one, this time Haris gets on top of the bounce and pulls it towards deep square leg for one.

SIX! The fielder has stepped on the ropes! Afif Hossain puts in a really good effort but in vain! Short and on middle, this is pulled towards the square leg fence. Shorter side but since it is off the splice, the fielder there does have a chance. Afif Hossain takes it but he seems to be losing his balance, throws the ball back in play. It is taken upstairs and replays show that he has stepped on the ropes.
Another single! Shorter and on off, this is guided towards point for one more.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Hammered and a boundary to start the over. A welcome one and that will release a little bit of pressure. Fuller and on off, this is lofted over the mid off fielder and it goes into the fence.
Outside off, Haris plays it late and down to third man for one.

Just over! That would have been a strange way to get out, very strange. This is short and on middle, Haris looks to pull but misses. It hits the helmet but then hits the back of the bat as Haris followthroughs. It lops just over the leaping keeper and behind for two.
Full and angling into the pads, Mohammad Nawaz looks to flick, he gets an inside edge onto the pad. It rolls on the leg side for one
Shorter and on the body, Mohammad Haris steps out and looks to pull, he gets an inside edge onto the body, it rolls on the leg side for one.
Around off, Haris looks to guide it down again but finds point.
Two! Good running! Length and outside off, this is guided down to third man for two.
Ebadot Hossain gets away with it! He bowls ths short of a length and on middle, Mohammad Nawaz miscues his pull shot back towards the bowler.
Another full toss, on middle, Mohammad Haris drills it towards mid on for a run. More drama in this over as it is called a no ball for overstepping. Free hit coming up...
A full toss, on middle, Mohammad Nawaz whips it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR OVERTHROWS! Ebadot Hossain serves this full and on middle and leg, Mohammad Nawaz misses his flick and gets hit on the pads as the ball rolls towards short third man. There is an appeal for LBW but turned down. The fielder has a shy at the batter's end as Nawaz is way out of his crease, but misses and the ball goes away for a boundary. Bangladesh giving away free runs here.
This is full and around off, Mohammad Haris shows intent and slashes it towards third man for a single.
Mohammad Haris walks out to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! Bangladesh gets two wickets in two overs and both the openers for Pakistan are back in the hut now. Ebadot Hossain bowls this short of a length and on off, Mohammad Rizwan slices it uppishly but straight to point where Najmul Hossain Shanto takes a good catch diving forward. Pakistan two down now.
Commentary.Howout: c Najmul Hossain Shanto b Ebadot Hossain

Commentary.Commentary: This is on a good length and on middle, Mohammad Rizwan knocks it back to the bowler.

Tossed up, full and on off, Mohammad Nawaz goes for the sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW, but turned down. Shakib Al Hasan takes the review. UltraEdge shows no bat involved and Ball Tracking shows that impact is outside off. The on-field decision of not-out remains.
A bit short and on middle, Mohammad Nawaz pushes it back to the bowler.
Floated, short and on middle, turning away sharply to the leg side, Mohammad Nawaz leaves it alone. It is called a wide.
Flatter and around leg, Mohammad Nawaz misses his flick again and gets hit on the pads.
Quicker, short and down the leg side, Mohammad Nawaz misses his flick. Wided.
Mohammad Nawaz walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Nasum Ahmed finally provides the breakthrough for Bangladesh and sends the opposition skipper back to the hut. He flights this up, full and on off, Babar Azam moves across to play the sweep, but gets a top edge towards short third man where Mustafizur Rahman takes a nice catch moving forward. Pakistan lose their first.
Commentary.Howout: c Mustafizur Rahman b Nasum Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, full and on middle, Mohammad Rizwan works it towards long on for a single.
Short and outside off, Mohammad Rizwan cuts it towards cover.

Drinks! Pakistan are going steadily in the chase and they are in strong position to get over the line. Bangladesh need wickets and they need it quickly. Both Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan are getting runs and this will give them more confidence. Another exciting passage of play awaits us. Also, Nasum Ahmed to bowl after the break.
A bit short and on middle, Babar Azam blocks it out.
Quicker one, full and on the pads, Babar Azam whips it towards deep square leg for a brace.
FOUR! Smashed! This is flighted, full and on middle, Babar Azam skips down the track and lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Looped up, full and on middle, Mohammad Rizwan uses his feet and eases it towards long on for a run.
Floated, full and on middle, Babar Azam sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up, full and on off, Babar Azam pushes it towards cover.
This is on a yorker length and on off, Babar Azam digs it towards point for a single.
Full again and on middle, Babar Azam drills it towards mid on where the fielder lets it through for a couple of runs.

Dropped! A half-chance, but Azam survives. Ebadot Hossain serves this full and on off, Babar Azam drives it uppishly towards cover where the fielder fails to grab it and deflects it in the deep. Two run taken!
Swing and a miss! This is on a good length and outside off, Babar Azam swings at it but misses.
Short and outside off, Babar Azam slashes at it but only connects with thin air.
Ebadot Hossain starts with a short delivery, outside off, Mohammad Rizwan cuts it past point for a single.
Ebadot Hossain comes into the attack now.
Another short delivery, on off, Mohammad Rizwan waits for it and guides it towards short third man for a run.
Short again and on middle, Babar Azam pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Quicker one, on middle, Mohammad Rizwan moves across and eases it towards long on for one.
Shortish and around leg, Babar Azam moves back and tucks it through square leg for a single.
Shorter in length and outside off, Babar Azam looks to cut it away but misses.
Floated, full and on off, Babar Azam moves across to play the sweep, but misses and gets hit on the pads.
This is short and on middle, Babar Azam goes for the pull shot but gets an inside edge towards fine leg for one.
Slower again, short of a length and outside off, Mohammad Rizwan cuts it towards sweeper cover for a run.
A slower one now, full and on off, Mohammad Rizwan drags it towards mid on and denies for the single.
Mustafizur Rahman bowls this on a hard length and outside off, angling away, Mohammad Rizwan slashes hard at it but cannot connect.
On a length and on middle, Babar Azam clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
This is full and outside off, Babar Azam drives it straight to covers.
Shortish and on middle, Babar Azam nudges it through mid-wicket for a run. Pakistan are on 35 for none after the Powerplay.
Darts this one full and down the leg, Babar Azam goes for the sweep, but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Floated, full on middle, Babar Azam pushes it towards mid on.
Flatter and around off, Babar Azam moves back and looks to cut but misses.
Tossed up, full and on off, Babar Azam pushes it back to the bowler.
Quicker, short and on middle, Mohammad Rizwan flicks it off the back foot through square leg for a single.
Nasum Ahmed repalces Shakib Al Hasan. He conceded five runs in his first over.
Short again and on off, Mohammad Rizwan slaps it past cover for another run.
Mustafizur Rahman bowls this short and outside off, Mohammad Rizwan slaps it wide of sweeper cover for a brace.
Slower one now, on a length and on off, Mohammad Rizwan pushes it towards point for a run. The fielder hits the stumps at the bowler's end and the batters get an overthrow run.
Goes full and on off, Babar Azam slices it uppishly but wide of cover for a single.
Short of a length and outside off, Mohammad Rizwan cuts it through cover-point for a single.
Mustafizur Rahman starts with a good-length delivery, on off angling away, Mohammad Rizwan slashes at it but misses.
Mustafizur Rahman comes into the attack .
Looped up, full and on off, Mohammad Rizwan drives it towards long off for a single. 11 runs from the over!
FOUR! Back-to-back for Rizwan! Shakib Al Hasan floats this up, full and on middle, Mohammad Rizwan goes down again and sweeps it in front of square this time for a boundary.
FOUR! Nice shot! This is tossed up, full and on middle, Mohammad Rizwan goes down and sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Slower through the air, on middle, Mohammad Rizwan leans on and blocks it out.
A bit short and on middle, Babar Azam tucks it towards square leg for one.
Shakib Al Hasan starts with a flighted delivery, full and on middle, Mohammad Rizwan sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Goes a bit full, on middle, Babar Azam drills it back towards the bowler.
This is on a good length and on off, Babar Azam pushes it towards cover.
FOUR! Perfect timing! Taskin Ahmed serves this a bit full, on middle and leg, Babar Azam stays there and drives it past the diving mid on fielder for a boundary.
Back of a length and on off, Babar Azam knocks it to the off side.
On a length and on middle, Babar Azam nudges it towards mid-wicket.
Good delivery! This is on a good length and around off, holds its line, Babar Azam looks to play at it, but withdraws his bat.
Floated, full and on off, Mohammad Rizwan pushes it towards backward point.
Short and outside off, Mohammad Rizwan cuts it towards cover where the fielder lets it through. Two runs taken!
Quicker one, full and on leg, Babar Azam tucks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up, full and on off, Mohammad Rizwan drives it towards long off for a single.
Flatter, on middle, Mohammad Rizwan looks to block but gets hit on the fingers as the ball bounces off the surface.
Nasum Ahmed starts with a short delivery, on middle, Babar Azam flicks it through square leg for single and gets off the mark.
Nasum Ahmed to bowl from the other end.
Full again and on off, Mohammad Rizwan knocks it towards cover. An eventful first over!
Fuller one and on off, Mohammad Rizwan pushes it towards point.
SIX! Pakistan and Mohammad Rizwan are underway! This is short and on middle, Mohammad Rizwan goes for the pull shot but gets a top edge over the fine leg fence for a biggie.

DROPPED! Taskin Ahmed bowls another good-length delivery, on off, nipping away, Mohammad Rizwan looks to poke at it but gets an outside edge towards the keeper where Nurul Hasan puts it down diving to his right. It was a regulation catch. but it goes begging.
BEATEN! This is on a hard length and on off, shaping away, gets some extra bounce off the surface, Mohammad Rizwan looks to play at it but misses.
Taskin Ahmed starts with a short-of-a-length delivery, on off, Mohammad Rizwan mistmes his cut towards cover.
